page_title: Xylem - every Claude Code session in one Mac window

sources.entry: Xylem - Native terminal for Claude Code with tabs that resume their sessions, context and cost tracking, and a panel for project skills, MCP and git. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/t1nkl/xylem) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Xylem
summary.one_liner: A free, native macOS app that wraps the Claude Code CLI with one tab per session, status marks for sessions waiting on you, and panels for usage, costs, skills, MCP and git.
use_cases: run several Claude Code sessions side by side
see which Claude session is waiting for input
track Claude Code usage and costs
manage project skills, MCP servers and hooks
browse project files and git changes while coding with Claude
summary.what_it_does: Xylem is a native Mac app that runs the real claude CLI in each tab, one tab per conversation. It marks which session is working or waiting for the user, and tabs can be placed in the sidebar or above the terminal. A panel shows past prompts, usage and costs, plus project skills, MCP servers and hooks. Project files and git changes can be opened from icons in the window. It is built in Swift with SwiftUI and AppKit using the SwiftTerm terminal emulator, with no web layer, and it reads Claude Code settings without changing them.
notable: Native Swift/SwiftUI/AppKit build with SwiftTerm, no Electron or web view
Universal binary for Apple silicon and Intel, requires macOS 15 Sequoia or later
Open source under GNU GPL v3 with tagged releases
Does not modify Claude Code settings; adds hooks per tab via --settings
caveats: Claude Code usage is billed by Anthropic separately through a Claude plan or API key
Mac only (macOS 15 or later); not distributed through the Mac App Store because of sandboxing
Requires Claude Code to be installed and working in the terminal
